description: A form section with an email invite input and a member list. The invite area contains an email input, a role selector (Select), and an invite button. The member list displays each member with a role selector and an actions dropdown.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between the invite email input, role select, invite button, and member row controls
Submits the invite when the email input or invite button is focused; activates dropdown menu items
Opens the role Select dropdown; activates buttons and menu items
Closes the role Select dropdown or the actions dropdown menu
Navigates options within the role Select or actions dropdown menu
Navigates options within the role Select or actions dropdown menu

focus.notes: Focus follows tab order through the invite form, then through each member row's role selector and actions button. Focus ring is visible on all interactive elements.

announcements: Invite input announces its placeholder and type
Role selectors announce the current role value
Member names and emails are announced in each row
The "You" badge is announced for the current user
Dropdown menu items announce their labels

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA (>4.5:1 for member names, emails, and labels)
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for borders, select triggers, and focus rings)

consumerResponsibilities: Provide a visible confirmation (e.g., toast) after inviting or removing a member
Ensure the current user cannot remove themselves or change their own role
Add aria-label to the invite email input if a visible label is not provided
